name: Card
description: A framework-free Web Component for article and product cards: a whole-card link that keeps its name, secondary actions that stay reachable, and hover treatments that answer the keyboard too.

variants.name: Default
variants.description: An article card, and the whole-card link that keeps the title as its name.

variants.name: Effects
variants.description: The five hover treatments, each of which answers focus as well as the pointer.

variants.name: Product
variants.description: Price, badge and rating, with actions that have to sit above the whole-card link.

variants.name: Horizontal
variants.description: The picture beside the words, and a card with no picture at all.

variants.name: Grid
variants.description: A row of cards of equal height, with pinned footers and clamped descriptions.

variants.name: States
variants.description: Loading, unavailable and current, each said in more than colour.
